body.statement: If \(\mathcal K\) is a nonempty compact subset of a finite-dimensional Euclidean space and \(d_S\) is continuous, then the argmin correspondence \(s\mapsto\operatorname*{argmin}_{q\in\mathcal K}d_S(q,s)\) has a Borel measurable selector \(\Pi\).

source.locator: Corollary 1, specialized to a compact action space and a continuous loss
source.verbatim_statement: there is a Borel measurable function φ_ε satisfying, for x ∈ G, f(x, φ_ε(x)) = inf f_x, if x ∈ I
